I created the Story **WPR-1** (`tickets/WPR-1.md`). It is in To Do with the label `plan-approved`. There is no Jira URL because tickets are files here. I didn't change any status, and I committed nothing.

The Story is "Wallpapers: guest list, search, filters, detail, download and purchase-gate coverage". It covers 23 of the 25 plan scenarios in four groups, each of which will become one Subtask, branch and PR:

| # | Group | Scenarios | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | List, search and scroll | WP-01 to WP-06 | Also builds the wiring: the `app` fixture, the entry page, the header, the cards component and the shared `CardLinkValidator`. |
| 2 | Category navigation and core filters | WP-07 to WP-12 | Introduces the filter bar component. |
| 3 | Filter combinations and detail page | WP-13 to WP-18 | The filter scenarios come first, then the detail page object. |
| 4 | Share, download, purchase gate and 404 | WP-19, WP-20, WP-21, WP-23, WP-25 | Introduces the download flow component and the shared `BuyModalPage`. |

- **Out of scope:** WP-22 and WP-24 are bug candidates, so neither has a test until a bug is filed. WP-22 gets a `@BUG:<KEY>` test through the normal bug flow. WP-24 stays a note because it depends on pinning one item by its GUID. The other bug candidates and the areas the plan excludes are listed in the Story too.
- **Reuse map:** I wrote it from what is on disk. `pages/` and `tests/` don't exist yet, even though CLAUDE.md describes `HeaderPage`, `BuyModalPage` and the others as present. The Story says group 1 creates the shared components, parameterised by href prefix and search scope so later areas can reuse them.
- **Group sizes:** the template says 4–6 tests per group, and these are 6, 6, 6 and 5.
- **Run notes:** I skipped the "wait for ok" step on the Story text, as you said.

The next step is for you to move WPR-1 to In Progress, then run `/implement-ticket WPR-1` in a fresh window.

There is nothing to stage. `tickets/WPR-1.md` and the ticket database were written by the Jira stand-in script, and you didn't ask for a commit.
